fields.name: edit_precision
fields.title: Edit Precision
fields.description: regular uses Generate; high uses Precise Edit with unchanged-pixel restoration. Both always prepare structured edit instructions.

fields.name: context_window
fields.title: Context Window
fields.description: Region to edit with high edit_precision. none edits the whole image, downscaled to at most 4194304 pixels. auto requires mask_url and fits the region around the mask; an oversized mask falls back to whole-image editing. Set context_window_box instead to pick the region yourself. Localized edits pres

fields.name: quality
fields.title: Quality
fields.description: Quality tier for either edit precision. Defaults to medium.

fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: auto preserves source geometry, downscaled by the provider if needed. Only unmasked regular edits accept named presets or custom sizes: dimensions >=256, multiples of 32, area <=4194304, ratio <=6:1. Named presets use standard fal dimensions.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: Random seed. Omit to choose automatically.
